• •contribute to differentiated ideas and thoughtful strategic perspectives that strengthen client dialogue and support origination efforts
• •support senior bankers in anticipating client priorities, executing against live opportunities and working seamlessly with internal and external stakeholders
•build and maintain rigorous financial and valuation models across live transactions and strategic assignments, including M&A, IPOs, follow-ons, private capital raising and other real estate, lodging and leisure corporate finance situations
•identify key issues early, assess alternatives with sound judgement and help drive practical, well-reasoned solutions under tight timelines

jobs.title: Sustainability Controller
jobs.description:
Would you like to make an impact on our Group’s sustainability governance and controls? Are you passionate about sustainability and ESG topics?
We’re looking for a Sustainability Controller like you to:
• enhance the governance framework over our Group's sustainability disclosures and reporting. This includes defining the governance process, timelines and documentation and control standards for metric owners and disclosure owners, as well as challenging and approving proposed metrics to ensure disclosures are fit for purpose
• act as a SME on various sustainability reporting topics. Be our point of contact for multiple stakeholders on matters relating to metrics, disclosures, and reporting. Coordinate with data providers to educate, enhance, and embed the control framework for sustainability reporting
• use your deep accounting and sustainability reporting knowledge to perform content and analytical reviews of our Group sustainability disclosures. Assess reporting revisions and impacts on reporting.
• support assurance activities over sustainability reporting. Act as an interface between auditors and internal stakeholders
• define, conduct and review metric reporting risk assessments
• integrate new ESG regulatory requirements and/or standards into business as usual.

jobs.description:
Your role
Do you enjoy working in a tax environment where accuracy and compliance matter? As a Tax Specialist, you will support VAT- and real-estate-tax-related compliance activities for Real Estate DACH, ensure high-quality data and documentation, and help deliver reconciliations, analyses and controls. In this role, you will support day-to-day tasks while actively contributing to ongoing process improvements in the tax environment.

We’re looking for a Tax Specialist to support the team with the following responsibilities:

• support quarterly fair value updates, including changes in use, input VAT adjustments and subsidies
• review and validate property allocation ratios
• prepare quarterly VAT returns; review documentation and file supporting documents to ensure timely submission
• perform annual turnover reconciliations and support VAT analyses and audits
• support preparation of real estate capital gains tax statements
• support real estate tax processes
• support direct tax and administrative tasks (e.g., supporting documents, data preparation)
• support continuous improvement of VAT processes and controls

titleByLocale.en: Accounting & Reporting Specialist – Real Estate DACH (with German)

titleByLocale.de: Accounting & Reporting Spezialist – Real Estate DACH (with German)

jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working with numbers and keeping things running smoothly? As an Accounting & Reporting Specialist, you will support periodic closings/reporting, ensure high-quality data, and help deliver analyses, controls, and cash flow reviews. In this role, you will support daily tasks while actively contributing to ongoing process improvements.

We’re looking for an Accounting & Reporting Specialist to support the team with the following responsibilities:

• accounting support and administration for various products (real estate funds, investment groups, mandates), including coordination with internal stakeholders
• create, review, and prepare analyses of key figures and statistics
• review cash flow statements and support liquidity planning
• perform control activities (e.g., completeness and plausibility checks, reconciliations, four-eyes controls) and document the results
• maintain and ensure the quality of data/baselines (e.g., master data, reporting parameters) in the relevant systems
• support periodic closings/reporting (monthly/quarterly/annually) and ad-hoc analyses
• contribute to process improvements and automation in the reporting and control environment

jobs.description:
Do you have a challenging mindset? Are you an innovative analytical thinker who likes to ‎question the status quo? Are you interested in quantitative risk modelling? Are you wondering where the limitations ‎of a model are?

We are looking for someone to:‎
• supervise and conducting independent validations of credit risk models in line with ‎current regulatory and internal policy frameworks:‎
• Collaborate with model developers and engage stakeholders across the ‎organization.‎
• Define validation scope based on model use case, complexity, and materiality.‎
• Lead the development and maintenance of validation standards and stay abreast of ‎regulatory and market developments.‎
• Evaluate the model risk, including model robustness analysis, identification of ‎limitations, and their assessment.‎
• Promote consistency in validation practices
• Guide and mentor junior validators.‎
• Drive internal initiatives

jobs.description:
UBS Business Solutions US LLC is seeking a Director, FX Options Trader in New York, NY
Are you an innovative thinker? Do you enjoy delivering enhanced change capabilities across a range of business functions? Are you passionate about IT process automation using cutting edge tooling platforms?

We’re looking for a Director, FX Options Trader to:
• Provide market-making and risk management for all Foreign Exchange (FX) Options emerging market currency pairs to the UBS client franchise utilizing specialized knowledge of internally developed tools and systems, including Market Maker Gui, FX Cockpit, Thor, Levitas and Brokertron.
• Focus on specialized field of knowledge in FX Options emerging markets currency to maintain accurate volatility surfaces across all the currency pairs by considering client flows and interbank market trades. Manage client flow risks and inventory positions.
• Leverage advanced knowledge of Market Maker Gui and Bloomberg to produce regular trade ideas and market updates, build and manage relationships with clients and prospective clients. Engage in FX Options initiatives to increase the UBS footprint in the U.S. market with a focus on Latin America, and partner with Sales and Strategy teams within Global Markets to capitalize on FX Options opportunities within the U.S.
• Apply expert understanding of specialized knowledge of our internally developed tools including T-Pricer and Market Maker Gui to improve the UBS E-trading offering to our U.S. clients via customized pricing profiles and enhanced technology in FX Options emerging markets currency pairs.
• Support the FX Options Trading division to efficiently and effectively run business operations, while maintaining responsibility for over 50 FX Options volatility surfaces.

jobs.description:
Êtes-vous passionné par les prêts bancaires ? Vous êtes autonome, fiable et possédez une grande conscience professionnelle ? Vous appréciez travailler dans un environnement dynamique et stimulant où les objectifs vous motivent ? Si vous avez répondu oui à ces questions, alors rejoignez notre équipe Credit Services et faites partie d'une entreprise où votre talent sera reconnu et valorisé.

• traiter les demandes de prêt approuvées à l'échelle nationale, en jouant un rôle clé dans la réalisation des projets de nos clients

jobs.description:
UBS Securities LLC is seeking an Associate Director, Global Markets Quantitative Analyst in New York, NY
Are you an innovative thinker? Do you enjoy delivering enhanced change capabilities across a range of business functions? Are you passionate about IT process automation using cutting edge tooling platforms?

We’re looking for an Associate Director, Global Markets Quantitative Analyst to:
• Develop and maintain sophisticated decision-making system at scale. Develop and support large scale real-time trading risk monitoring system to support multi-asset risk management within global markets.
• Build out scenario analytical platform to support risk management of portfolios and client margin management. Build scalable solutions to identify opportunities for prime brokerage, Delta 1 trading, inventory management, funding, lending and collateral optimization.
• Engage and understand balance sheet and risk requirements and/or controls. Lead technology design discussions for scalability and performance.
• Can work hybrid (In-office/remote).
